title: 054c Dead camel thorn trees in Deadvlei Photo by Giles Laurent.jpg
author: Giles Laurent
description: Dead camel thorn trees (Vachellia erioloba) in Deadvlei, Namibia. These trees grew approximately 900 years ago when periodic flooding of the Tsauchab River created a fertile marsh, but they died between 600 and 700 years ago after encroaching sand dunes obstructed the water flow.
